name: happy
description: Recorded live against api.elfa.ai on 2026-11-23 with deno task record (trimmed and scrubbed). The key's plan is not charged the 1-credit base, so x-elfa-credits reads 0 on the 1-credit v2 endpoints (the zero claim is pruned and the published card settles) and 4 on the 5-credit v2 endpoints (the claim settles, the card rides out as mismatch.derived). v3 reports its list price and x-elfa-credits-detail.

data.summary: A widely reposted Solana Breakpoint newsletter framed the event around a 'Token Supercycle,' saying tokenized Anthropic ($ANT) debuted on Solana on IPO day, Solana 1.0 marked its graduation from 'mainnet beta' to 'mainnet,' tokenized equities on Solana crossed $1.22B in circulating value with 2M+ holders, and 21Shares marked one year of its Solana ETF ($TSOL).

Posts noted U.S. spot Solana ETFs brought in about $4.4M last week, their first positive week after six consecutive weeks of withdrawals, with SOL around $70; one poster said it was too early to call a recovery. Nexo separately cited $644.1M in year-to-date net inflows into U.S. spot Solana ETFs and about $1.14B in net assets.
